page.layout: One printed page, single column of verse lines, with a woodcut-style ornament below the text. No margin notes. Signature "AD" at lower right, which is a gathering mark.

main_text.p:
Medio aufferre venenis, modò ferro &
Sine justâ malè committere lite
Gladiantes, animos aut inimicos agitantes.

Reliquum nil faciunt denique pensi,
Genus audax scelera in cuncta nefanda,
Nisi cœlum, & polus, & Dis sibi cedat pater ipse.

Orere ô lux, ubi acuto Deus ictu
Adigat fulminis in viscera terræ,
Vel in æquor, volitantes in Iberis simul omnes

Ratibus, cum Duce; vel corpora fœtis
Canibus projiciens, pestiferam auram
Animarum populante stygio ventilet igni.

Ibi tum Pax oleæ instar revirescet,
Sua cives retinebunt habitacla,
Sua Cleri sacra salva & sua Reges tabulata.

Ubi grex & gregis omnis scabiosi
Lœiola periit spes; Parasiti,
Homicida, genus audax scelera in cuncta nefanda.

page.notes: Ornamental woodcut/printer's flower below the verses, not transcribed. Faint show-through text from the reverse page is ignored. The signature "AD" at lower right is a gathering mark. Some words are unclear in the scan at the line ends; the verse is read as printed.
